description: User-facing surfaces + docs: new tenant Meta App settings UI page, connect-page runtime effective-config fetch replacing build-time NEXT_PUBLIC_* reads, .env.example reframing (Model A fallback + fix stale client-only Config ID claim), and scratchpad.md update. Depends on FEAT-002 (the /api/meta-app route the UI and connect page call). Grounded in the actual connect page, sidebar (already links /dashboard/settings), dashboard layout (server auth gate), and current .env.example / scratchpad.md.
steps: Create src/app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx per design §6 as a 'use client' page using existing Card/CardContent/CardHeader/CardTitle/CardDescription, Input, Label, Button primitives (same import paths as src/app/dashboard/numbers/add/page.tsx). On mount GET /api/meta-app; populate metaAppId + configId inputs with returned effective values; secret field always empty, type='password', never pre-filled; helper line 'Secret is stored' when hasSecret && source==='tenant', else 'No tenant secret stored (using platform app)'; source badge 'Using your own app' vs 'Using platform app' from source.

Settings Save -> PUT /api/meta-app sending metaAppSecret ONLY if the user typed one; configId per §5 rule (send the string when set, send configId: null when clearing a previously-set value, omit the key when untouched). Clear/Disconnect -> DELETE /api/meta-app then re-fetch to reflect source:'platform'/hasSecret:false. Surface API errors (including a 401) inline in the same red-box pattern as the connect page; do NOT self-redirect (the /dashboard server-layout guard in src/app/dashboard/layout.tsx is the auth boundary). Never render the secret back.

Modify src/app/dashboard/numbers/add/page.tsx per design §7: remove the module-level const META_APP_ID = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_META_APP_ID and META_CONFIG_ID reads. Add const [cfg, setCfg] = useState<{ appId: string | null; configId: string | null } | null>(null). In a mount useEffect, fetch('/api/meta-app') and setCfg({ appId, configId }); on failed/500 fetch treat as not-configured (leave cfg null), do not crash. Keep the WA_EMBEDDED_SIGNUP message listener.

Connect page: gate FB SDK init/script-injection on cfg?.appId (make the init effect depend on cfg) and call window.FB.init({ appId: cfg.appId, autoLogAppEvents: true, xfbml: false, version: 'v19.0' }). handleConnect uses cfg?.appId/cfg?.configId; when either is absent keep the EXACT existing message verbatim ('Embedded Signup is not configured yet. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_META_APP_ID and NEXT_PUBLIC_META_CONFIG_ID, or enter credentials manually.') — do NOT reword it (AC-7). FB.login uses config_id: cfg.configId. Preserve the sdkReady / 'Facebook SDK is still loading' guard. The manual-credentials form and its /api/numbers/manual submission stay untouched and MUST remain gated only on showManual (never on cfg) so a null/failed cfg never hides the manual path.

Update .env.example per design §8: reframe META_APP_ID/META_APP_SECRET as the platform (Model A) fallback used only when a tenant has no TenantMetaApp row (Model B overrides); note META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN stays platform-level/shared (per-tenant GET handshake out of scope; only POST signature verification becomes per-app). In the 'Client-exposed Meta values' block REPLACE the false 'only ever read client-side' sentence with wording that NEXT_PUBLIC_META_CONFIG_ID is read both at build time (client bundle) AND server-side by resolveMetaAppCredentials / GET /api/meta-app, and that the connect page fetches the effective config id at runtime so a tenant's own Config ID overrides it without a rebuild; soften the adjacent 'requires a REBUILD' sentence to scope it to the inlined client constant only. In the Meta-side-prerequisites footer correct the Configuration-ID bullet (no longer client-only) and correct the META_APP_SECRET line (verifies platform-app Model A tenants' webhooks; Model B tenants verify against their own secret; keep it set so platform-app delivery updates aren't 401'd). Keep ENCRYPTION_KEY block as-is. Introduce NO new env var. Placeholders only.

Update scratchpad.md per the global scratchpad rule: refresh Last updated; add TenantMetaApp to a Schema section; add GET/PUT/DELETE /api/meta-app to the Backend endpoints table; document src/lib/meta-app.ts (resolveMetaAppCredentials precedence tenant->platform, MetaAppConfigError) in Architecture; update the Onboarding-paths and webhook notes to describe per-app bounded-candidate-secret signature verification and the runtime effective-config fetch on the connect page; correct the 'NO server-side META_CONFIG_ID' note; add a /dashboard/settings UI entry; note the Model A/B fallback model and that no new env var was added; prepend a dated Change log entry (newest first).
acceptance_criteria: src/app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx loads GET /api/meta-app, reflects hasSecret/source (secret never pre-filled, helper says 'Secret is stored' not 'valid'), saves via PUT (secret sent only when typed, configId null-to-clear / omit-to-keep), clears via DELETE then re-fetches, and surfaces errors inline without self-redirect.

src/app/dashboard/numbers/add/page.tsx fetches effective appId+configId from GET /api/meta-app at runtime, initializes FB.init/FB.login with those values, shows the verbatim 'Embedded Signup is not configured yet...' message when either is absent, keeps the manual-credentials path (/api/numbers/manual) untouched and reachable regardless of cfg.

.env.example documents the platform vars as the Model A fallback with the corrected (not client-only) Config ID wording and corrected META_APP_SECRET footer line, and introduces no new env var; scratchpad.md reflects the new model/endpoint/resolver/webhook/connect-page/settings changes with a dated Change log entry.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it completes with no type errors (settings page and connect page compile; no server-only imports in the client components).

Reason through design §6/§7: settings load reflects hasSecret/source; empty secret field preserves stored secret on save; clear reverts to platform; connect page drives FB init/login from runtime cfg; verbatim not-configured message; manual form always reachable.

Doc-accuracy review of .env.example against §8 (no stale 'only ever read client-side' wording, no unconditional-mandatory META_APP_SECRET claim, no new env var) and of scratchpad.md (new model/endpoint/resolver/webhook/connect/settings represented; dated Change log entry at top).
findings:
DONE. `npm run build` passes (exit 0; /dashboard/settings and /dashboard/numbers/add both compile as client pages, no server-only imports).

=== Settings page (src/app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx, NEW, 'use client') ===
- On mount GET /api/meta-app -> populates metaAppId + configId inputs with effective values; secret input is type='password', autoComplete='new-password', ALWAYS empty (never pre-filled).
- Helper line: 'Secret is stored' when hasSecret && source==='tenant', else 'No tenant secret stored (using platform app)'. Deliberately 'stored' not 'valid' (GET never decrypts).
- Badge: 'Using your own app' (source==='tenant') vs 'Using platform app'.
- Save -> PUT /api/meta-app. Secret sent ONLY if the user typed one (trimmed non-empty). configId: send trimmed string when set; send configId:null when the field is cleared AND cfg.configId was previously set; omit the key otherwise. Re-fetches shape from the PUT response and resets the secret field.
- Disconnect own app (shown only when source==='tenant') -> DELETE /api/meta-app, then loadConfig() re-fetch to reflect source:'platform'/hasSecret:false.
- Errors (incl. 401) surfaced inline in the connect-page red-box pattern; NO self-redirect (relies on /dashboard server-layout auth gate). Secret never rendered back. Button variant='outline' confirmed available.

=== Connect page (src/app/dashboard/numbers/add/page.tsx, MODIFIED) ===
- Removed module-level const META_APP_ID/META_CONFIG_ID (NEXT_PUBLIC_* reads).
- Added cfg state { appId, configId } | null; a dedicated mount useEffect fetch('/api/meta-app') -> setCfg; res not ok OR catch -> cfg stays null (treated as not-configured), page does not crash. Guarded with an `active` flag for unmount.
- SDK init effect now gates on cfg?.appId and DEPENDS ON [cfg]; FB.init called with appId = cfg.appId. WA_EMBEDDED_SIGNUP message listener preserved.
- handleConnect: guard `if (!cfg?.appId || !cfg?.configId)` -> sets the VERBATIM 'Embedded Signup is not configured yet. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_META_APP_ID and NEXT_PUBLIC_META_CONFIG_ID, or enter credentials manually.' (unchanged per AC-7). sdkReady / 'Facebook SDK is still loading' guard preserved. FB.login uses config_id: cfg.configId (narrowed by the guard).
- Manual form + POST /api/numbers/manual UNTOUCHED and still gated only on showManual (never on cfg).

=== .env.example (MODIFIED, no new var) ===
- META_APP_ID/META_APP_SECRET reframed as the platform (Model A) fallback used only when a tenant has no TenantMetaApp row (Model B overrides).
- META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN noted platform-level/shared (GET handshake + single endpoint not per-tenant; only POST signature verification is per-app).
- 'Client-exposed Meta values' block: replaced the stale 'only ever read client-side' sentence with build-time-inlined-AND-server-side wording (read by resolveMetaAppCredentials / GET /api/meta-app) + runtime effective-fetch note; softened 'requires a REBUILD' to the inlined client constant only.
- Footer: corrected the Configuration-ID bullet (no longer client-only; read both places + runtime effective fetch) and the META_APP_SECRET line (verifies platform-app Model A tenants; Model B verify against their own secret; keep set so platform-app delivery updates aren't 401'd); prerequisites now per-app.
- ENCRYPTION_KEY block unchanged. Env-var name set is byte-identical to before (grep-confirmed) — NO new env var.

=== scratchpad.md (MODIFIED) ===
Last updated -> 2026-10-14. Added: Model A/B Meta app section; src/lib/meta-app resolver in Architecture; GET/PUT/DELETE /api/meta-app rows in the Backend table; per-app bounded-candidate-secret webhook flow rewrite (step order + intended behavior change); UI pages subsection (settings + connect page); corrected config table rows for META_APP_ID/SECRET and both NEXT_PUBLIC_ Meta vars; corrected the NEXT_PUBLIC_* rebuild gotcha; new dated Change log entry at top (newest first).

=== NOT touched ===
/api/numbers/manual, the manual form, send/template routes, serializeNumber, the /api/meta-app route (FEAT-002), the resolver/schema/migration (FEAT-001).
